reviews.text: Good place for stay chilling
Great shop/cafe nice friendly staff

The shop has a cozy atmosphere and a cool, stylish décor. It offers an extensive menu of coffee and other beverages, with seating areas available both indoors and outdoors. The space features pleasant lighting and background music that enhance the ambiance. The staff are friendly, polite, and helpful, offering great recommendations and engaging in casual, welcoming conversation with customers.

reviews.text: Really nice place! ☕️ The coffee was excellent, the atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, and the whole place has a great vibe. Definitely worth visiting if you’re around Surin. Highly recommended!
